surface_forms: le directeur de l'hôtel de Balbec

appraisal_events.evidence: L'église de Balbec « faisait un avec tout le reste, semblait un accident » ; la Vierge du porche se trouve « réduite maintenant à sa propre apparence de pierre », « métamorphosée [...] en une petite vieille de pierre dont je pouvais mesurer la hauteur et compter les rides » ; le narrateur n'accuse « de ma déception que [...] ma fatigue, mon incapacité de savoir regarder ».
appraisal_events.explanation: The long-imagined Balbec collapses into the banal (tramways, a Café, the Comptoir d'Escompte), deflating the narrator's imaginative authority; he is left disappointed and turns the blame on his own incapacity to see.

appraisal_events.evidence: « j'aurais voulu me présenter à lui dans une compagnie plus prestigieuse que celle de ma grand'mère qui allait certainement lui demander des rabais »
appraisal_events.explanation: Facing the imagined hotel director, the narrator treats his grandmother as socially inadequate, discount-seeking company; the mature narrating voice exposes this as the young man's snobbish vanity while the local movement still lowers her standing.

status_effects.explanation: The dominant local outcome is deception: the desired encounter with the milkmaid ends in separation and Balbec itself yields a disappointment he does not even dare to confess.
She is locally devalued as unprestigious, bargain-hunting company, a diminishment reinforced by the botched errand that sent Françoise off toward Nantes.

ambiguities: Swann's remembered praise (« C'est délicieux, c'est aussi beau que Sienne ») is set against the narrator's disillusion, but he explicitly refuses to blame anything but his own fatigue and incapacity; whether the passage thereby discredits Swann's judgment or only the narrator's expectations is genuinely underdetermined, so no event targets Swann.

The opening milkmaid episode carries a narrator-endorsed 'désir de vivre qui renaît', which would pull toward elevation, but it involves no named character and ends in non-contact (« Elle ne me vit pas », the train departs); weighting it against the Balbec deflation is a judgment call, and the arrival sequence was read as the unit's dominant movement.
